ModMetaData.author: Honor Mod Series
ModMetaData.description: Honor.SocietyApologies before staging, witness social memories, one-day colony rumors, blood-family honor and repeated-insult rivals. The offender may offer; only the victim may accept. Both need to be awake and within 12 cells. Adds a 600-tick preparation window. Requires Core 0.2.1+ and Harmony 3; NO DLC required. 한국어: 사과 제안·당사자 수락·목격·하루 뒤 정착지 소문·혈연 명예·반복 모욕 숙적. 결투 준비 전 600틱 여유가 있습니다. Core 0.2.1 이상과 Harmony 필수, DLC 필수 아님. Source: https://github.com/Ale6974/HonorModSeries Collection: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3825922644
